friendly_name: Enforce verbatim pass-through for main-agent delegations
source_description: GitHub issue #374 (P1-bug). Main agent (Sonnet 4.6, default WhatsApp recipient) paraphrases Kent's habit/tasker/escalation replies before delegating to specialist agents, bypassing the deterministic parsers built by #371 (habits) and #309 (escalation). Vikunja comments still write but JSONL state-log substrate is silently empty for any day Kent replies via WhatsApp. Same architectural risk gates #310 (Phase 7 tasker). Fix: harden /data/services/openclaw/data/AGENTS.md §'Habit tracking delegation' (and analogous sections for escalation and the future tasker delegation) with a HARD verbatim rule and FORBIDDEN-paraphrase examples. Also address long-lived session caching: AGENTS.md changes won't take effect until sessions reset; need a kill-session helper or rotation mechanism + cutover doc.
